ROOT.triggerdef: CREATE TRIGGER CDN.PrcKarty_UaktualnijPikElem ON CDN.PrcKarty FOR UPDATE AS begin SET NOCOUNT ON if update(Prc_Akronim) update CDN.PikElem set PIE_Kod=inserted.Prc_Akronim from inserted inner join deleted on deleted.Prc_GIDNumer=inserted.Prc_GIDNumer inner join CDN.PikElem on PIE_Znacznik='P' and PIE_Kod=deleted.Prc_Akronim SET NOCOUNT OFF end
